description.narrative: Insatsen syftar till att sekondera fyra observatörer från FBA till OSCE special monitoring mission i Ukraina. FBA har ansvar för finansiell uppföljning och rapportering av insatsen samt rekrytering och utbildning av observatörer inför utresa. Övergripande mål med insatsen är att öka stabiliteten och säkerheten i Ukraina baserad på respekt för mänskliga rättigheter. Insatsen är högst relevant för den rådande situationen och konflikten i Ukraina. Insatsen är även relevant för rapportering i förhållande till den humanitära situationen i Ukraina.

The intervention aims to support OSCE in deploying international observers in Ukraine. The special monitoring mission aims to reduce the tensions in the eastern regions of Ukraine, reducing tensions and fostering peace stability and security.

The purpose of this contribution was to allow FBA to deploy additional Swedish monitors as part of the OSCE Special Monitoring Mission (OSCE SMM) in Eastern Ukraine. Sweden had been supporting OSCE monitors since 2014, however in 2015 there was a need for the monitoring capacity to be scaled up. Therefore this contribution was meant to allow for an additional 4 monitors to be deployed for 15 months from 2015 onwards. The long-term outcome of the intervention was 'stability and security in Ukraine based on the respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms including the rights of minorities'. The medium-term outcome was 'reduced tensions and stability throughout the country'.

Certain OSCE monitors were deployed. They carried out their task as part of the Folke Bernadotte Academy (FBA) mandate to provide OSCE monitors. The deployment of OSCE observers was delayed due to a fatal accident in April 2017 where two OSCE monitors perished when their vehicle ran over a landmine. The killed monitors were not seconded by Sweden but FBA considered that the situation was sufficiently dangerous to halt the planned deployment of observers. Once FBA decided to second staff again the funding from this contribution was no longer neccesary as FBA was able to scale up staffing of the OSCE SMM with funding from other sources.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
